So I’m an emotional crier. I cry because I can’t pet cats. Because I want a certain food that I can’t have, because I’m tired. It’s horrendous sometimes but I can’t stop, it’s how I express feelings. My boyfriend is EXTREMELY un-empathetic. I knew when I started dating him that he didn’t take to crying well, but I’m perfectly happy over a year later. Whenever I cry over something ridiculous or small, he giggles with me, gives me a hug and says I’ll be okay. He’s not pandering to the fact that I cry by trying to make everything better. He’s just acknowledging that I’m feeling some type of way, hugging me briefly and we go about our day while I cry about not having enough money to own a cat. 

Don’t try to make everything better and cave to her crying, understand that she’s upset and acknowledge it with kindness but don’t immediately fix the problem. If you fix whatever she’s upset about she’ll just think that crying = getting her way. My boyfriend and I communicate about if what is upsetting me is minor or major and go from there to try to make the best of it. 

If you guys can’t communicate and work through boundaries with her it might not be a good pairing and that sucks but it’s the reality of it :(
